app.name: MineMyDinner
app.tagline: Dig tonight's dinner out of your saved recipes and your fridge.

import.title: Import recipes
import.textLabel: Paste recipe text or a link
import.screenshotsHint: 1 to 5 PNG, JPEG, or WebP images, up to 10 MB each. Images are not stored.
import.batchHint: Separate dishes with a line of ---, or with blank lines. Up to 50 dishes. Links in the file are saved as sources but not opened.
import.pasteSuggestion: This page could not be read. Copy the recipe text from the page and paste it above.
import.batchQueued: {count, plural, =0 {No dishes were extracted.} one {# dish is ready for review.} other {# dishes are ready for review.}}
import.modelNotice: Imported content is sent to a model provider for extraction.

errors.monthly_cap: This month's model spending cap is reached. Raise LLM_MONTHLY_CAP_USD or try next month.
errors.models_unavailable: No model is available right now. Try again later.
errors.invalid_url: This is not a valid http or https link.
errors.blocked_address: This link points to a local or private address, which is not allowed.
errors.robots_disallowed: This site's robots.txt does not allow reading this page.
errors.fetch_failed: The page could not be loaded.
errors.not_html: This link is not a web page.
errors.no_main_text: No recipe text was found on the page. It may need a login.
errors.text_too_large: The text is too long. Keep it under 20,000 characters.
errors.unsupported_image_type: Use PNG, JPEG, or WebP images.
errors.too_many_items: The file has more than 50 dishes.
errors.unreadable_encoding: The file's text encoding could not be read. Save it as UTF-8.
errors.invalid_parent: The parent entry is not valid.
errors.unknown_ingredient: An ingredient link is not valid. Link it again.
errors.unknown_cookware: A cookware link is not valid. Link it again.
errors.network: The server could not be reached.

review.title: Review recipe
review.empty: There are no drafts to review.
review.unsavedNotice: Drafts are kept only on this page. Reloading or closing it loses them, and they would need to be extracted again.
review.saveFailed: Saving failed: {error} Your edits are kept.
review.allergyWarning: Allergy warning. The recipe can still be saved.
review.allergenConflict: {name} contains {allergen}, which you are allergic to.
review.ruleConflict: {name} matches one of your allergy rules.
review.checkYourself: The dictionary and extraction can be wrong. Check the actual ingredients for allergens yourself.

line.name: Name
line.skipped: Skipped: saved without a dictionary link

allergens.title: Allergens
allergens.suggested: A model suggested these. They take effect only after you confirm.
allergens.noneSuggested: The model suggested none. This does not confirm that there are none.
allergens.unavailable: Suggestions are unavailable. You can still choose allergens or leave them unknown.
